method.identity_limits: Queue implied destinations and source name suffixes are corroborating labels only. A cell is bindable only with one target RVA, a complete direct scalar access survey, one writer survey, an independent HIGHLOW MOV/LEA/PUSH anchor outside the 18 pending rows, and a fresh exact-size owner check in the references command.
